summary: Check a literal prefix before routing a value.
documentation: startsWith compares a string prefix at a chosen position and returns a Boolean. It performs a case-sensitive comparison and does not remove spaces or interpret regular expressions.
inputs: A prefix string and optional starting position.
returns: true when the prefix matches; false otherwise.
caution: An empty prefix matches every string. A RegExp argument throws; this is not URL validation.
scenarios: Route invoice references beginning with INV- to billing staff.
Recognize a documented command prefix in a support console.
Separate internal SKU families before showing their forms.
title: Recognize invoice references
problem: Input is a string. Return true only when it begins with the exact prefix INV-. Do not trim or change case.
goal: Use String.startsWith() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Check the first characters against the literal prefix.
